Alpha stands before a blurry mirror, fixating on her right eye until its reflection expands, covering the entire surface.
Luna awakens within the mirror, drowsily acting spoiled and clingy toward her sister.
Alpha
Something's off about Cradle.
Alpha
She's been collecting my blood. Got herself a whole boxful.
Luna catches this crucial information and sits up sharply, alert as a small predator.
Luna
I sense your murderous intent. Do you want to kill her?
Alpha
No. Just thinking about switching doctors. Can't exactly entrust my life to someone I don't trust...
Luna
You should let her continue. I'm quite curious to see what bold moves Cradle might make. She might surprise us yet.
Luna
For instance, she might create a perfect vessel capable of housing me. By the way, does she still enjoy making those puppets?
Alpha
As usual... Alright.
Alpha
I'm heading out, Luna. You look exhausted.
Alpha seized immense power after that incident, but was forced to seal away Luna's soul. For a single body, two souls have proved too heavy a burden.
She has been dashing endlessly between the Mist and the city, searching for a suitable <phonetic=body>vessel</phonetic> for Luna.
Luna
Don't worry. We'll never find ourselves in any real danger even if there's a threat.
Luna
As long as I exist, no one will ever threaten you, Sis.
Alpha
Luna, sometimes I worry you're just a hallucination. Maybe that's why we can only meet here.
Luna
So you've been trying to kill yourself all along? Throwing yourself into battles, hoping that I would appear and take control of this body in those near-death moments?
Luna
Which one is truly the madwoman between us?
Luna
You cast aside the name Lucia... you became Alpha, just so you'd never forget that night.
Luna
But Sis, "Alpha" is our pride, not your sin.
Alpha
Luna, it was because of you that I became Alpha. And because of you... I can never forgive her.
Alpha
This hatred I carry for "myself" is the only thing left that lets me feel you. If I lose that too... I don't know how to keep living.
Luna
...Please, Sis, don't die... Don't leave me...
Luna vanishes in Alpha's embrace, a loss the Countess has never grown accustomed to.
